headline: On October 21, 1984: Niki Lauda wins his 3rd F1 title
captionCards: Lauda won by just 0.5 points over Prost
Lauda remains the only driver to win with Ferrari and McLaren
instagramCaption:
Niki Lauda clinches his third F1 championship.\nIn a thrilling finish at the Portuguese Grand Prix, Austrian driver Niki Lauda secured his third and final Formula One Drivers' Championship by just half a point over his McLaren teammate, Alain Prost. This victory made Lauda the only driver to win titles with both Ferrari and McLaren. His legacy as one of the greatest drivers in F1 history continues to inspire racers today.
